instruction: Could you bookmark the active page to the bookmarks bar for me?

metadata.explanation: Task requires bookmarking the active page (second tab - Illustrated Transformer) to bookmarks bar. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric. Paraphrase of original instruction.

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to persist bookmarks to disk for verification
Getter (get_bookmarks) correctly reads Chrome's Bookmarks file and extracts bookmark structure
Metric (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_websites_urls) correctly checks if expected URL is present in bookmark bar
Expected URL (https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/) correctly identifies the active tab based on config
Minor issue: Metric uses subset check, so would pass even if both tabs were bookmarked (not just active page)
Minor issue: No verification that bookmark was newly added vs pre-existing
Minor issue: Instruction assumes second tab is active but doesn't explicitly verify active tab state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using exact match instead of subset check if instruction requires ONLY the active page to be bookmarked
Consider adding verification that the bookmark didn't exist before task execution
Consider explicitly verifying which tab is active before bookmarking to ensure correct tab is bookmarked
